data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"A test constrains rather than describes when the subject's failure is masked by the test's own registry; the 3-of-26 distribution arises because mutations no guard catches are reported as caught, so the test's registry constrains what counts as a failure before any description can occur.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the registry is independently audited and the loss rate persists, the test describes rather than constrains.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the masking is uniform across all modules, the distribution is a description of registry behavior.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the 3-of-26 result is reproducible without the registry, the constraint claim fails.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The registry is the test's memory of what it has seen fail. When a mutation is lost, the registry marks it as caught, so the test constrains its subject by reclassifying failure as success. The 3-of-26 result is the number of mutations that escaped this reclassification, not the number that actually failed.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
